label: Dunvegan western road crossing
phase: Northern expansion of independent validation against unchanged frozen TPS13
point_definition: Centre of the western meeting of the coast-side loop, southeast road and southwest/northeast through route; the separate junction to the northeast is excluded.
identity_evidence: The coastal loop passes inland behind Marsh Point and bends southeast into this crossing. The through route approaches from the southwest and continues northeast across the nearby watercourse; a separate northern road junction lies beyond it. The southeast arm and surrounding stream/road order also match the original modern network. Original roads3842/155492 and highways60159/155494 share the exact node. Historical line thickness and road generalization limit precision; no engineering-change bound is inferred.
